channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Gestão Tarcísio inicia demolições em local da futura sede do governo
item.description: The Tarcísio de Freitas administration has begun demolishing three buildings in central São Paulo to make way for the new state government headquarters, carried out by company Habitem, despite the contract with consortium MEZ-RZK assigning demolition responsibilities to the latter. CDHU stated Habitem was chosen because the properties had already been expropriated and were in state possession following an MPSP operation that found the sites used by organized crime. The demolition is part of a larger plan involving 67 properties, with precautionary inspections underway to compensate residents for any collateral damage.

item.title: Após cinco anos, Malafaia ficará longe do 7 de Setembro na Paulista
item.description: Pastor Silas Malafaia will not organize the September 7, 2026, protest on Paulista Avenue after five consecutive years leading the demonstrations there. He denies seeking distance from the event, stating he was previously invited by Jair Bolsonaro and has no ties to the PL, which is now organizing the act with Flávio Bolsonaro as a central figure. The PL has reserved Paulista Avenue from 10 a.m. to 8 p.m., expecting 20,000 people, with plans for a sound truck, stage, tents, and medical services.

item.title: Florida pone a prueba en sus primarias el dominio republicano
item.description: Florida, once a national swing state, now presents itself as a Republican stronghold in its primaries ahead of the 2026 elections. Early and mail-in voting has already begun to select candidates for governor, Senate, and the House of Representatives, with the main primaries set for August 18. The outcome will test whether Republican dominance in the state has solidified after decades of competitiveness.

item.title: Los partidos argentinos comienzan a tomar posiciones de cara a la carrera electoral de 2027
item.description: Argentina is beginning to position itself for the 2027 presidential elections, with Javier Milei’s administration seeking alliances to pave the way for re-election, including a rapprochement with former president Mauricio Macri through his sister Karina, who oversees electoral list formation. The Peronist opposition, in power since late 2023, has struck a fragile truce to block an electoral reform that would eliminate the primary elections (PASO), which are crucial for selecting their candidate. These developments signal increasing polarization and early electoral strategy formation over a year ahead of the vote.

item.title: Lula e presidente do México discutem parceria entre Petrobras e Pemex
item.description: Lula and Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum discussed strengthening the partnership between Petrobras and Pemex, as well as expanding bilateral trade, highlighting the untapped potential of current agreements between Brazil and Mexico. They also addressed regional Latin American issues, including the restoration of diplomatic relations between Mexico and Peru, the humanitarian crisis in Cuba, and efforts to combat femicide, with Lula presenting a proposal from First Lady Janja Lula da Silva on the latter topic.

item.title: Eleições 2026: Como tirar segunda via do título de eleitor?
item.description: Voters can obtain a free second copy of their voter registration card online through the TSE's Self-Service Electoral Portal or the e-Título app, without needing to visit an electoral office in most cases. The service remains available even when voter registration is closed for other updates, and the e-Título holds the same legal validity as the printed version for voting, provided it includes a photo or is presented alongside an official photo ID.

item.title: Lula de chapéu na urna: o que dizem as regras do TSE e especialistas em direito eleitoral
item.description: Lula will wear a hat in his official photo for the 2026 electronic ballot, following medical advice after skin cancer treatment. While TSE regulations prohibit head accessories, recent precedents — such as the 2022 approval of a cap for a federal deputy candidate — suggest the hat may be allowed if it does not hinder voter recognition or carry electoral propaganda. The TSE declined to comment on the specific case, leaving the decision to regional electoral courts.

item.title: Na largada, Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro tentam recriar cenas do passado
item.description: The 2026 presidential campaign kicks off with Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro attempting to recreate political scenes from the past: Lula returns to São Bernardo do Campo to revive the memory of the ABC strikes, while Flávio Bolsonaro heads to Copacabana Beach to relive the glory days of his father, Jair Bolsonaro. The article is subscriber-only and evokes a sense of déjà vu in the electoral race.

item.title: Consultas, limites e ritos: entenda a Lei da Reciprocidade, após governo Lula abrir processo contra os EUA
item.description: The Lula government notified the United States of the initiation of a reciprocity process in response to U.S. tariffs on Brazilian products, based on the 2025 Economic Reciprocity Law. The law enables the Executive to retaliate against unilateral foreign measures without new congressional approval, provided proportionality and exhaustion of other options. U.S. tariffs on Brazil total 37.5% (25% specific + 12.5% general), with exceptions for certain products.

item.title: Abertura de processo de reciprocidade marca mais um capítulo negativo da relação Lula x Trump: relembre idas e vindas
item.description: The relationship between Lula and Trump has been marked by oscillations between confrontation and rapprochement, highlighted by Lula's support for Kamala Harris in 2024, Trump's 50% tariff on Brazilian goods, and diplomatic moments such as the UN meeting and the White House visit. Despite signs of improvement, new U.S. trade measures — including labeling criminal groups as terrorists and proposing new tariffs — have reignited tensions.

item.title: Reciprocidade contra Trump: sem canais de negociação analistas veem decisão política
item.description: The Lula government notified the U.S. of the start of a reciprocity process in response to Trump-era tariffs, which include a 25% rate specific to Brazil and a 12.5% rate affecting multiple nations. The tariffs are cumulative, though exceptions exist for certain exported goods. Analysts note there are no active negotiation channels between the two governments.

item.title: Kassab diz que Centrão está com Lula e que chance de Flávio Bolsonaro ser eleito é 'zero'
item.description: Gilberto Kassab, president of the PSD and vice-presidential candidate, stated that the Centrão parties are aligned with Lula and that Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) has zero chance of being elected. He criticized Bolsonaro and said that once the campaign officially begins, Flávio will be exposed and lose support. Kassab also noted that the PSD and its allies stepped aside to give Ronaldo Caiado more TV time, increasing it from 50 seconds to nearly two minutes and 20 seconds, which he believes will be decisive.

item.title: Cury propõe semipresidencialismo e reforma do STF em plano de governo
item.description: Writer Augusto Cury (Avante) filed his government plan for the Presidency of the Republic with the TSE, proposing three institutional reforms: adoption of semipresidentialism, reducing the STF to nine justices with eight-year fixed terms appointed by judicial, prosecutorial and bar associations, and elevating the Foreign Ministry to a 'Secretary of State' role. The 200-page plan includes 18 structural projects in education, health, entrepreneurship and environment, emphasizing emotional management, financial education, telemedicine, technology-based women's protection and AI-integrated policing. Cury declares R$242 million in assets and aims to overcome ideological polarization with a 'capitalist mind and a social heart'.

item.title: Incerteza sobre contas públicas eleva parcela da dívida atrelada à Selic ao maior patamar em 20 anos
item.description: Uncertainty over Brazil's public finances and the international environment has led the National Treasury to increase the share of federal debt linked to the Selic rate to its highest level in 20 years. This strategy reflects a move toward greater flexibility and reduced exposure to long-term risks amid fiscal and external volatility.

item.title: PT patrocina posts enaltecendo governo, e PL impulsiona conteúdo para desgastar Lula
item.description: Before the official electoral campaign begins on August 16, the PT is paying to boost posts that praise Lula's government, while the PL is doing the same to amplify critical content against the president, aiming to damage his image and attract voters on social media.

item.title: Ato de Renan Santos na Faculdade de Direito da USP gera polêmica, e grupo protesta
item.description: Law students at USP protested against presidential candidate Renan Santos (Mission) during an event at the Faculty of Law in Largo São Francisco on Thursday night (08/13/2026). The demonstration arose in response to the candidate's presence, sparking controversy among attendees.

item.title: Lula recebe pela primeira vez familiares de vítimas da ditadura para filme no Alvorada
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva received, for the first time in his three terms, family members of victims of the military dictatorship at the Palácio da Alvorada. The meeting took place during a screening of the film 'Honestino', a biopic of student leader Honestino Guimarães, who was killed by the dictatorship and whose body was never found. The gesture symbolizes a historic recognition of human rights violations during the authoritarian regime.

item.title: A medida do TSE após filiação de Flávio ao Missão e tentativa de mudança de registro de Lula
item.description: The TSE temporarily suspended new registrations in the Filia system after the false affiliation of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro to the Mission party and an attempted false affiliation of President Lula. The measure aims to prevent further fraudulent filings, while the TSE restored Flávio’s affiliation with the PL and denied hacking, attributing the incident to improper use by a user linked to the Mission party.

item.title: Penduricalhos dos tribunais de contas ainda escapam ao cerco do STF
item.description: The Supreme Federal Court (STF) ruled that seven State Courts of Justice must suspend irregular payments and repay amounts exceeding limits set in the 'penduricalhos' judgment. The decision strengthens transparency and social oversight, enabling citizens to scrutinize and challenge the Judiciary's payrolls. Despite challenges, access to information is expanding public spending monitoring.

item.title: Em live, Flávio Bolsonaro defende carteira de motorista para jovem a partir de 16 anos
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) advocated in a live stream for lowering the minimum age to obtain a driver's license from 18 to 16, linking the proposal to reducing the age of criminal responsibility. He framed the measure as part of a broader agenda promoting juvenile responsibility and public safety.

item.title: Caiado é aplaudido por empresários em SP, pede apoio nas redes e doações, com boletos de R$ 20 mil
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) met with business leaders in Santos to seek support and donations for his presidential campaign, distributing envelopes with R$20,000 boleto slips. He urged entrepreneurs to post support on social media, criticized the current government and the PT, and likened today's economic situation to Dilma Rousseff's 2015 administration, pledging to present reforms on January 5, 2027, if elected.

item.title: Mansão de R$ 6,2 milhões no Lago Sul fez patrimônio de Flávio disparar
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's wealth grew 370% between 2018 and 2026, driven by the purchase of a R$ 6.2 million mansion in Lago Sul, DF, in 2021. He financed part of the property with BRB but paid it off in 2024, three years early, claiming he sold an apartment in Barra da Tijuca and a Kopenhagen franchise. The mansion spans 1,100 m² with luxury finishes, a gym, gourmet area, and 24-hour armed security.

item.title: O recado do TSE após Flávio Bolsonaro aparecer filiado ao Missão
item.description: The TSE clarified that Flávio Bolsonaro's affiliation with the Mission party was not due to a hacker attack, but the improper use of party-provided tools for registering affiliates. Responsibility for affiliations lies with the parties, and the case will be investigated by the Federal Police. Since party affiliation is a constitutional requirement for candidacy, and the Mission party already has a candidate, this could create an electoral impasse.

item.title: Plano de Flávio Bolsonaro usa escândalo do INSS para desgastar Lula
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL's presidential candidate, aims to exploit the scandal involving fraudulent discounts at INSS linked to Lulinha, President Lula's son, to undermine the ruling Workers' Party. His government plan promises to combat and prevent INSS fraud as a core electoral strategy to damage Lula's image. The proposal emerges amid mounting pressure on the federal executive over alleged irregularities in social security.

item.title: Lula e Sheinbaum discutem proposta de Janja contra feminicídio
item.description: Presidents Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Claudia Sheinbaum held a videoconference to discuss Brazil-Mexico cooperation, including a proposal by First Lady Janja Lula da Silva to combat femicide internationally and joint projects between Petrobras and Pemex.

item.title: DC barra tentativa de filiação fraudulenta de Lula
item.description: A fraudster attempted to falsely enroll President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva into the Christian Democracy (DC) party using his personal data, including ID, CPF, and voter ID. The party detected the fraud before it reached the Superior Electoral Court (TSE) and blocked the process. DC president João Caldas warned that such attempts are likely to increase during the electoral period.

item.title: Escritor Augusto Cury registra candidatura no TSE e declara R$ 242 milhões em bens
item.description: Writer and psychiatrist Augusto Cury registered his presidential candidacy with the TSE, declaring R$ 242 million in assets, including R$ 121 million lent to Filadélfia Nature Participações. This is his first electoral run, and his campaign platform proposes near-zero public deficit, spending cuts, semipresidentialism, and a 'revolution' in education centered on critical thinking.

item.title: TSE suspende sistema de filiações após Flávio ser incluído no Missão
item.description: TSE President Minister Kássio Nunes Marques temporarily suspended the processing of new party affiliations via the Filia system after presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro was improperly added to the Missão party despite being affiliated with PL. The measure aims to prevent further irregular changes to party registrations while the court investigates the incident and checks for similar attempts involving other candidates, including a failed effort to alter Lula’s affiliation. With the candidacy registration deadline on Saturday (August 15), regularizing Flávio’s status is urgent to avoid electoral process interference.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro declara R$ 8,2 milhões em bens ao TSE; vice informa R$ 565 mil
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) declared R$ 8.2 million in assets to the TSE for the 2026 presidential race, while his running mate Alfredo Gaspar (PL) reported R$ 565 thousand. Bolsonaro’s declared wealth increased by 370% since 2018, largely due to a Brasília property valued at R$ 6.2 million. The ticket’s registration was confirmed after a dispute over an alleged affiliation with the Missão party, which the TSE overturned.

item.title: Lindbergh aciona PF e pede acareação de Flávio e Renan
item.description: Federal Deputy Lindbergh Farias (PT-RJ) filed a complaint with the Federal Police to investigate alleged fraud in the affiliation of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) to the Mission party, as recorded in the TSE system. The lawmaker requests the preservation of digital data, the requisition of records from the TSE, the Senate, and internet providers, and also calls for a confrontation between Flávio Bolsonaro and Senator Renan Calheiros (MDB-AL).

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro declara patrimônio de R$ 8,18 milhões, valor mais de três vezes superior ao de 2018
item.description: Senator and presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) declared a net worth of R$ 8.18 million to the TSE in 2026, over three times the amount declared in 2018 (R$ 1.73 million, inflation-adjusted). This represents a 211% increase, driven by a Brasília property valued at R$ 6.2 million, R$ 1 million in investment funds, and other assets including bank accounts and equity stakes. In 2018, his wealth was mainly in financial investments and a Barra da Tijuca apartment, plus a stake in a Kopenhagen franchise under investigation for money laundering linked to Alerj — a case later dismissed due to procedural annulments and statute of limitations.

item.title: Flávio declara R$ 8,1 milhões em bens à Justiça Eleitoral
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) declared R$ 8.18 million in assets to the Electoral Justice, including a Brasília Lago Sul house valued at R$ 6.2 million. The declaration was made as part of his presidential candidacy registration with the Superior Electoral Court (TSE). Additional assets and investments were also disclosed in the patrimonial statement.

item.title: Brasil está na contramão do mundo, diz deputado sobre maioridade penal
item.description: Deputy Aluisio Mendes (Republicanos-MA), president of the special committee analyzing the reduction of criminal responsibility age, argues that 16- and 17-year-olds should be criminally liable for violent crimes, claiming Brazil is 'out of step with the rest of the world' by keeping the age at 18. He cites Argentina as an example and notes that since 16-year-olds can vote, they should also bear criminal responsibility for serious acts, advocating for an intermediate approach limited to violent crimes.

item.title: Patrimônio de Flávio Bolsonaro cresceu 370% em 8 anos
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro declared assets of R$ 8.186 million to the TSE in 2026, a 370% increase from 2018, driven by the purchase of a mansion in Lago Sul for R$ 6.226 million. The asset growth occurred despite investigations into alleged money laundering linked to his former company, Bolsotini Chocolates and Café, tied to the 'rachinhas' scheme in the Alerj.

item.title: Carlos Machado registra candidatura ao governo de SP e declara patrimônio de R$ 27 mil
item.description: Professor Carlos Machado (PCB) filed his candidacy for governor of São Paulo with the TSE, declaring assets worth R$ 27,000 — down from R$ 57,000 in his 2022 municipal vice-mayor run. His holdings include an individual microenterprise (R$ 15,000) and a vehicle (R$ 12,000). His running mate, Felipe Queiroz, declared R$ 535,200 in assets.

item.title: TSE suspende processamento de novas filiações após caso Flávio Bolsonaro e identifica tentativa contra Lula
item.description: The TSE temporarily halted processing of new party affiliations in the Filia system after detecting improper use of credentials to attempt changing the affiliation of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and a failed attempt to alter President Lula’s party registration. The measure, which does not affect electoral deadlines, aims to investigate fraud and strengthen system security, with the case referred to the PGE and Federal Police.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz também ter sido alvo de tentativa de filiação fraudulenta ao PT
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a 2026 presidential candidate, denounced a fraudulent attempt to affiliate him with the PT and the Mission party, claiming fake emails were used to register him without consent. He also revealed that scammers attempted to affiliate President Lula with the Christian Democracy party using false data. The confusion was resolved by the TSE and Minister Kassio Nunes Marques, who canceled the Mission party affiliation and restored him to the PL. During a live stream with his running mate, Flávio unveiled his government plan.

item.title: TSE suspende sistema de filiação partidária após caso Flávio e tentativa de alterar partido de Lula
item.description: The TSE suspended the processing of new party affiliations in the FILIA system after detecting attempts to improperly change the party affiliation of President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva (PT) and Senator Flavio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ). Bolsonaro had been wrongly registered as affiliated with the Mission Party, blocking his presidential candidacy, but the TSE restored his PL affiliation and removed the fraudulent link. Despite the attempts, both Lula and Bolsonaro maintained regularized affiliations, and the April 4 deadline for party affiliation had already passed.

item.title: Prefeitura de São Paulo tem crédito de R$ 3,6 bilhões aprovado um dia após União liberar verba bilionária ao estado
item.description: The Senate approved a R$ 3.62 billion credit for São Paulo City Hall, sourced from the IDB and World Bank, to purchase over 1,100 electric buses and fund the second phase of the Avança Saúde program. The decision came less than 24 hours after the federal government authorized a R$ 5.4 billion loan guarantee for the state of São Paulo, ending a bureaucratic deadlock amid public disputes between Governor Tarcísio de Freitas’ administration and President Lula’s government.

item.title: TSE suspende sistema de filiações partidárias após fraude contra Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques suspended the processing of new party affiliations following suspicions of fraud involving Flávio Bolsonaro's name. The measure aims to ensure electoral system integrity and prevent improper manipulation of party databases.

item.title: Simone Tebet registra candidatura ao Senado por SP e declara 10 milhões de patrimônio
item.description: Simone Tebet (PSB) filed her candidacy for the Brazilian Senate from São Paulo, declaring R$10.6 million in assets, with R$8.9 million attributed to rural land in Alvorada do Sul (MS) acquired through an anticipated inheritance from her mother. She leads in voter intention polls with 26.8% according to the Ideia/ACSP survey and is running under the 'Federação Brasil da Esperança' coalition, backed by President Lula. Tebet has been active in politics since 2002, serving as state deputy, mayor, vice-governor, and senator from Mato Grosso do Sul until 2023.

item.title: Flávio propõe reformar Judiciário e criar modelo prisional inspirado no de El Salvador
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a presidential candidate in 2026, proposes reforming the Judiciary to reduce the individual power of ministers and judges, creating a prison model inspired by El Salvador's, and classifying criminal factions as narcoterrorist organizations.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro promete retomar Casa Verde e Amarela e construir 2,5 milhões de residências
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, presidential candidate for the PL party, proposes to revive the Casa Verde e Amarela program to finance 2.5 million homes, offering the lowest possible interest rates for homebuyers. The program, introduced during Jair Bolsonaro's administration, replaced Minha Casa, Minha Vida as an alternative to Workers' Party-era housing policies.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro defende que parlamentares possam ser julgados por instâncias inferiores
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL presidential candidate, proposed in his government plan to end the STF's criminal jurisdiction over lawmakers. The change would allow deputies and senators to be tried in lower courts, such as the STJ and TRFs.

item.title: Plano de governo de Flávio Bolsonaro propõe tesouraço e novo teto de gastos
item.description: Presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) unveiled a government plan proposing a 'tesouraço' to cut spending and taxes, alongside a new spending ceiling. The initiative aims to replace the current fiscal framework, reviving a rule abandoned during the transition from Jair Bolsonaro’s to Lula’s administration.

item.title: Flávio diz que e-mails do Missão viraram “spam”
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) stated that automated emails sent by the Missão party to his institutional Senate account were classified as 'spam' by his team, concerning a membership he denies requesting. The comment was made during a livestream on Thursday, the 13th, and relates to prior difficulties he faced in registering his presidential candidacy.

item.title: Lula critica bets e diz que população deve evitar dívidas com jogo
item.description: President Lula criticized betting and warned the population to avoid going into debt through gambling, distinguishing productive debt (for purchasing essential goods or improving quality of life) from gambling-related debt, which he deemed harmful and based on lies. He advocated for government stimulation of consumption within families’ payment capacity, excluding gambling. Lula participated for the first time in the RAIS data presentation, highlighting formal job creation since the start of his mandate in January 2023 through June 2026.

item.title: Derrite é condenado pelo TRE-SP por propaganda eleitoral antecipada
item.description: The São Paulo Regional Electoral Court (TRE-SP) fined federal deputy Guilherme Derrite (PP) R$ 5,000 for premature electoral campaigning after he shared an edited video on social media urging support for Flávio Bolsonaro as president and himself as senator. The rapporteur ruled the content clearly exceeded pre-campaign limits by naming specific candidates and calling for public adherence to a political project. The court also ordered the immediate removal of the video, subject to daily fines, with an appeal possible.

item.title: Governo de SP aciona STF e, horas depois, União avaliza empréstimo de R$ 5,4 bilhões
item.description: The São Paulo government, led by Tarcísio de Freitas, sought an STF injunction to unlock a R$ 5.4 billion loan that had been stalled since May. Shortly after, the federal government, through the Ministry of Finance, approved the guarantee, with Banco do Brasil as the lending institution and the state acting as guarantor to secure lower interest rates. The funds will finance infrastructure projects, including metro expansion and highway duplication.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro registra candidatura no TSE
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) filed his presidential candidacy with the TSE on the evening of August 13, 2026. The submission included the DRAP and required documents for validation by the 22-PL party.
